meta.title: chore: migrate from Poetry to uv
meta.body_summary: Migrate the project from Poetry to uv for dependency management, claiming faster installation times and improved reproducibility.

perf_labels.notes: Devin migration from Poetry to uv bumped security findings and incorrectly replaced README with Gitleaks content; PR closed in ~22 minutes with no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3381 changed lines across 18 files, this is a large migration by absolute volume. As a build-tooling performance PR it was closed without merge, consistent with the high-risk scope and no maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: Semgrep bot flagged a virtualenv command injection vulnerability in requirements.dev.txt and AWS access key detections in README (from replaced Gitleaks content); the PR also replaced the project README with Gitleaks documentation indicating a severe content error.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster dependency installation and improved reproducibility with uv.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without human review after automated security findings and incorrect README replacement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Automated toolchain migration with large scope and content errors; no maintainer engagement or perf evidence illustrates process barriers for agent-authored tooling changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: Semgrep bot performed static analysis and flagged security vulnerabilities and hardcoded secrets.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes manual test steps but no before/after timing data; no benchmark or profiler evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by drdee within 22 minutes; no fix attempts or human feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Migrate dependency management from Poetry to uv: remove pyproject.toml and poetry.lock, add requirements files, update Dockerfile, docker-compose, .pre-commit-config.yaml, and add new CI workflow guardrails.yml.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README.md was inadvertently replaced with Gitleaks readme content, later attempt to restore; LICENSE file added then removed; small formatting changes in front-end files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: remove Poetry files, add requirements, update Docker/pyproject.yml, add LICENSE (incorrect README).
Subsequent commits attempt to restore original README, remove LICENSE, iterate on CI workflow and pyproject.toml configuration.
No human review; PR closed shortly after last commit.

review_signals.summary: Flagged virtualenv command injection (CVE-2024-53899) in requirements.dev.txt and multiple AWS access key detections in README (from Gitleaks content).
Devin bot introduced itself and offered to address comments and CI failures.
Comment 'wow! this is cool' from non-maintainer user.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR migrating from Poetry to uv with many file changes.
Semgrep bot posted multiple security findings within 1 minute.
Devin bot acknowledged review and continued making CI workflow adjustments.
PR closed by drdee with no comment ~22 minutes after creation.
